mapper.sql: select r.reward_id, r.app_user_id, r.lead_id, l.display_name as lead_name, r.reward_type, r.title, r.product_code, r.status, r.ref_type, r.ref_id, r.dedup_key, r.confirm_by, r.confirm_time, r.used_time, r.create_time, r.remark from abr_reward r left join abr_lead l on l.lead_id = r.lead_id
mapper.insert: insert into abr_reward (app_user_id, lead_id, reward_type, title, product_code, status, ref_type, ref_id, dedup_key, create_time, remark) values (#{appUserId}, #{leadId}, #{rewardType}, #{title}, coalesce(#{productCode}, ''), #{status}, coalesce(#{refType}, ''), #{refId}, #{dedupKey}, now(), #{remark}) on conflict (dedup_key) where dedup_key is not null do nothing
mapper.update: update abr_reward set status = #{toStatus}, confirm_by = case when #{toStatus} = 'issued' then #{operator} else confirm_by end, confirm_time = case when #{toStatus} = 'issued' then now() else confirm_time end, used_time = case when #{toStatus} = 'used' then now() else used_time end where reward_id = #{rewardId} and status = #{fromStatus}
